**Overview**

**About the Role**

RealDefense is looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented, Senior FP&A Analyst to help run planning, forecasting, and performance reporting. You’ll report to the Director of Finance and partner with the heads of our revenue-generating teams to provide visibility on business performance, collaborate on forecasting, and help teams determine where to focus next.

This role is for someone who is analytical and enjoys transforming data into meaningful insights. You’re capable of synthesizing information from multiple sources and translating analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that drive business decisions and improve performance. You’re also a builder who sees AI and automation as opportunities to do better work, not just faster work. You’ll have real room and support to enhance how our finance team operates.

**What You’ll Do**

**Planning & Forecasting**

* Own the annual budget and rolling forecast processes, including consolidated and department-level budgets, in partnership with the finance team and functional leaders.
* Develop and maintain the corporate three-statement model and driver-based models for revenue, expenses, and working capital.
* Run scenario and sensitivity analyses to support planning and strategic decisions.

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly and intra-month flash reports covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and KPIs against budget and forecast.
* Deliver variance analysis and management commentary regarding financial results that explains what happened, why it happened, and what we should do about it.
* Produce weekly and monthly KPI reporting for the executive team and build dashboards tracking unit economics and SaaS/subscription metrics.
* Develop materials for senior leadership and the board, including management meeting decks, quarterly board packages, and lender and PE sponsor reporting.
* Support M&A and strategic projects as needed, including target modeling, valuation, diligence, and post-acquisition tracking.

**Business Partnering**

* Act as a key finance partner for Marketing, Call Center, Business Development, and the Product and Operations teams. Help them set targets, track results, and understand the drivers behind performance.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis on pricing, marketing spend, headcount planning, and vendor and partner economics.
* Work with Accounting on month-end items that affect the forecast, and support audit requests and internal controls documentation for FP&A processes.

**Process Improvement & AI**

* Identify and lead automation opportunities across FP&A workflows – data extraction, reconciliations, report generation, and variance commentary – using AI tools, scripting, and BI platforms.
* Evaluate, pilot, and drive adoption of AI-enabled finance tools (e.g., LLM assistants, AI-native software, workflow automation), with appropriate controls, documentation, and data governance.
* Partner with the BI/Data team to build a single source of truth for financial and operational data.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally in a technology, SaaS, or subscription business.
* Strong attention to detail. You check your own work, reconcile to the source, and catch errors before anyone else does.
* Advanced Excel skills with experience building driver-based models.
* Working knowledge of marketing and subscription metrics such as CAC, LTV, churn, cohorts, and payback.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* A solid understanding of GAAP, three-statement linkages, and working capital.
* Experience in a PE-backed or founder-led company, including board and lender reporting, is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills: able to partner with senior executives and operational teams.
* Strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset, able to translate financial insights into business actions.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to speed up analysis or automate work.
* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. An MBA, CPA, or CFA is a plus.

**Why Join**

You'll have real ownership and direct visibility with senior leadership. Your work will shape how a growing company measures success and makes investment decisions. This is a chance to build data science practice rather than inherit it.

Description:

Verda Healthcare, Inc. is a Medicare Advantage Prescriptions Drug Plan (MAPD) organization committed to the idea that healthcare should be easily and equitably accessed by all, currently available in Texas and Arizona. Our mission is to ensure that underserved communities have access to health and wellness services, and receive the support needed to live a healthy life that is free of worry and full of joy. We are looking for a Compliance Analyst to join our growing company with many internal opportunities.

Are you ready to join a company that is changing the face of health care across the nation? Verda Healthcare is looking for people like you who value excellence, integrity, care and innovation. Align your career goals with Verda Healthcare, Inc. and we will support you all the way.

**Position Overview**

The Compliance Analyst will support the Medicare Compliance Program and help ensure compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements. This position conducts internal audits and monitoring, supports oversight of delegated entities and first tier, downstream, and related entities (FDRs), and supports the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) in fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) prevention, detection, and investigation activities. * Support the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) in the prevention, detection, and investigation of potential fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA), including intake and triage of referrals from the compliance hotline, internal departments, and data analytics.
* Assist with FWA investigations, including claims and medical record review, data analysis, records requests, and complete case documentation.

* Prepare agendas, minutes, materials, and reports for the Compliance Committee and Board of Directors.
* Assist with compliance hotline intake, compliance investigations, and regulatory reporting and responses to CMS and state regulators.
* Stay informed on Medicare Advantage and Part D regulatory changes and share relevant updates with the compliance team.
* This position requires daily in-office attendance to ensure effective collaboration and support of compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Professional Competencies**

* **Integrity and Discretion:** Handles confidential information, including investigation and personnel matters, with professionalism and sound judgment.
